reads.text:
$ aws secretsmanager create-secret --name prod/orders/db --secret-string file://db.json
{ "Name": "prod/orders/db" }
$ ./deploy.sh --env production --dry-run

gate.activity_summary: Moved plaintext credentials into a secrets manager.

evidence.statement: Moved plaintext credentials into a managed secrets store and changed a deploy script to read them at runtime.
